title: 16 saal ka ladka aur Waqar Younis: Karachi 1989 🏏 #shorts
facebook_title: 16-year-old Sachin and Waqar: one debut Test, two legends
caption:
15 November 1989, Karachi. 16 saal ke Sachin Tendulkar aur 17 saal ke Waqar Younis — dono ka pehla Test, ek hi match mein. 🏏

Waqar ne Sachin ko 15 par bowled kiya… aur ek mahine baad Sialkot mein, naak par bouncer lagne ke baad bhi Sachin bole: "Main khelega!" 57 run banaye aur India ne Test bacha liya.

Aapka favourite kaun — Sachin ya Waqar? Comment mein bataiye! 👇
